data.one_liner: Detect keyboard visibility using bottom view inset in Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget and controller to listen for keyboard visibility changes and size. It exposes callbacks, streams, and boolean helpers.
use_when: You need to react to keyboard show/hide events
You want to adjust UI when keyboard appears
You need keyboard size for layout calculations
avoid_when: You only need a simple focus change listener
You are building a non-Flutter platform
You prefer a different method of detecting keyboard (e.g., MediaQuery)
strengths: Supports callbacks, streams, and boolean helpers
weaknesses: Relies on bottom inset, may be inaccurate on some devices
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and wrap Scaffold with KeyboardDetection widget
